sections.title: Objective and Scope
paragraphs: The purpose of this policy is to define allowances like Food Allowance, Night Shift Allowance, and Night Shift Travel Allowance (Fuel Allowance) for Cotelligent associates. These guidelines are applicable to associates designated to work in different timings of Night shift.

sections.title: Food Allowance
paragraphs: Associates need to be present in office and work beyond 9:30 PM IST to avail the Food Allowance. The amount paid is Rs. 100/- per day. Associates working Telecommute (WFH) are NOT eligible for this benefit.

sections.title: Food Expenses Reimbursement
paragraphs: If an associate works from office or client location on weekends or standard holidays with manager approval, they can claim food bills. Reimbursement is made as per actuals up to the following limits: Breakfast or Snacks: Rs. 100 per person per day. Lunch: Rs. 200 per person per day. Dinner: Rs. 200 per person per day.

sections.title: Night Shift Allowance
paragraphs: An associate must work in the defined night shift timings to avail Night Shift Allowance. Minimum 6 hours must be worked during the defined night shift window. Night Shift Allowance is NOT payable if a half-day leave is applied. Associates working Telecommute are also eligible. Night shift allowance is paid as per the shift timings in the offer letter or project timings defined by the manager.

Shift-wise Night Shift Allowance rates: 3 PM - 12 AM: Rs. 200/- per day. 4 PM - 1 AM: Rs. 200/- per day. 5 PM - 2 AM: Rs. 200/- per day. 5:30 PM - 2:30 AM: Rs. 400/- per day. 6 PM - 3 AM: Rs. 400/- per day. 6:30 PM - 3:30 AM: Rs. 400/- per day. 7 PM - 4 AM: Rs. 400/- per day.

If an associate works beyond defined shift timings, they must take approval from the reporting manager and inform HR to avail extra shift allowance. Any change in shift timings must be approved by the reporting manager and shared with the HR team.

sections.title: Night Shift Travel Allowance
paragraphs: Associates must work from office beyond 12 AM IST to avail Night Shift Travel Allowance. Associates working Telecommute are NOT eligible. Associates availing company cab (preferably women associates) are NOT eligible for this travel allowance.

This allowance is paid based on the distance from the associate's home to office. The associate must provide a declaration with current residential address to the HR department. Minimum 6 hours must be worked during the defined night shift window. If the residential address changes, the associate must update HR on or before the 25th of the month.
Night Shift Travel Allowance rates by distance: Up to 12 Kms: Rs. 3,500/- per month. 13 Kms to 25 Kms: Rs. 4,500/- per month. 26 Kms and Above: Rs. 5,500/- per month.
